interpretation: Source review, context inclusion, instrumented counters, bounded executions, symbolic domains, provider workflow completion, public-fork compatibility, and reconciliation are separate measurements. Missing executable denominators are not 100 percent coverage. Passing counts, report counts, and agreement are not security votes or universal proofs.

properties.limits: Aggregate conservation does not itself assert each beneficiary rate; larger domains and payout permutations rely on source/fuzz rather than universal proof.

properties.limits: Original Halmos covers two tickets/two owners; late invariants are bounded; arbitrary callback words and uniformity are not universally proved.

properties.limits: A selected prize can self-attest dishonestly or later pause, seize, or refuse transfer. Receiver acceptance and ownerOf do not prove lasting truthfulness or outbound capability.

properties.limits: Three narrow own-recipient or bearer-loss variants only; no arbitrary EOA theft, buyer-refund loss, or cross-raffle accounted-fund drain.

properties.limits: No genuine off-chain fulfillment, complete billing/configuration/finality proof, or arbitrary callback-word formal proof. Modulo bias and reorg remain bounded/external.

properties.limits: Exact-transfer quote assumption; arbitrary ERC721 honesty cannot be inferred; safe receipt does not prove future outbound capability.

properties.limits: Local gas observations and selected profiles are not universal block-inclusion guarantees.

properties.evidence_summary: 16 SDK, 25 web, 8 subgraph tests; codegen/build/typechecks; canonical ABI sets 125/26.
properties.limits: Top-level ABI order differs; no complete deployed wallet/browser/indexer/chain flow.

properties.evidence_summary: Independent formulas and balance deltas; 11 standalone Python tests; rollback diagnostic.
properties.limits: Python tests are not Solidity differential verification; rejected lazy redemption mutates Python state without EVM rollback.

properties.limits: Git-sourced era-contracts lacks an npm packument attestation; signatures do not certify all dependencies or deployed administration.

rf002_expanded_variants.mechanism: Sponsor selects the predictable address of a future same-factory clone; after deployment an honest NFT sponsor prize can be transferred into that clone and stranded.
Future recipient becomes registered; sponsor quote-proceeds release reverts while unrelated protocol-fee release remains possible. The backed immutable claim is unavailable.
Owner-selected transfer to an existing clone from another factory passes the factory-local registry check; the receiving clone has no general outbound owner call.

rf002_limits.demonstrated: Narrow own-recipient or bearer-claim loss under selector-controlled destination choices.
not_demonstrated: Attacker selection of an unrelated victim's immutable recipient
Drain of another raffle's accounted quote funds

foundry_release.limits: Native calls include caught reverts and no-op returns and are not all successful economic actions.

echidna_extended.limits: Earlier 180-second and 3000-target attempts remain incomplete/short history. Native rejected-input and revert counts are unknown.

medusa.limits: The other 20 checks are not independent invariants.

halmos.domains: Two symbolic amounts 1..16, two actors/tickets, exact-transfer quote, fixed VRF mocks, both refund orders, all bounded winners, selected payout orders.
halmos.limits: Not proof over arbitrary actors, amounts, transfers, callback words, hostile tokens, prize code, or payout permutations.

limits: Two raffles and four actors; ordinary entry counts 1..25 plus a large-buy action; refund batches at most eight; bounded warps and corruption modes.
Full 100-ticket batches, every dishonest-prize delivery branch, and paidPrice greater than msg.value were not universally exercised.
Manticore unavailable; Halmos substitution disclosed; two timeout obligations are not passes or counterexamples.
Invariant handler is one actor buying entries 1..1000 in one active raffle.
Echidna is purchase-only and becomes a no-op after at most 64 successful buys.
Separate lifecycle/adversarial examples do not turn the active-only invariant campaign into terminal or multi-actor proof.
Source-first seal bytes changed between watcher observations; current seal verifies but the older observed bytes were not retained.
Conditional mock demonstration, not a named deployed collection result.
Separate TIA-02 uses vm.prank for a contract that has no claim-originating method; it does not prove that recipient can originate the call.
